_comment: Shared by model/prepare.py and web/src/features.ts. JSON has no comments: see feature_spec.md for the reasoning behind every choice.

hand_assignment._note: Browser only. Kaggle data already has hands in slots. Use HandLandmarker handedness labels only as a fallback when no pose is detected: their meaning has changed across versions (tasks-vision 1.2.3 documents them as the subject's hands for an unmirrored image).
hand_assignment._evidence: datacheck v1, 500 sequences: Kaggle left_hand is nearer pose 15 in 99.93% of frames, right_hand nearer pose 16 in 99.93%

input_aspect._note: Browser only, applied to raw landmarks before features. Training data is used as-is. x and y are normalized to image width and height separately, so landmarks from a frame with a different H/W must be rescaled in y to look like training data.
input_aspect.browser_transform: y' = 0.5 + (y - 0.5) * (H / W) / train_H_over_W, x unchanged, where W x H is the frame given to MediaPipe
input_aspect._evidence: datacheck v1: rigid palm-bone length is most rotation-invariant at H/W 1.20 (xyz) / 1.36 (xy); 3:4 portrait and 1:1 both fit, 16:9 landscape clearly does not

presence.rule: a group is present in a frame if any of its selected x values is not NaN

trim.rule: drop leading and trailing frames where neither hand is present; if no frame has a hand, keep all frames

mirroring.decide: after trim, count frames with left_hand present (nL) and right_hand present (nR); mirror iff nL > nR
mirroring.x_transform: x' = 1 - x (raw normalized image coords, before centering)

normalization.statistic: per_sequence: center = nanmean over frames of per-frame midpoint; scale = nanmean over frames of per-frame distance
normalization.apply: x' = (x - cx) / scale; y' = (y - cy) / scale

fallback_if_no_shoulders._evidence: datacheck v1 medians: mid-shoulder x 0.49, y 0.65; shoulder width 0.56 (per-sequence mean). Shoulders were present in 100% of sampled frames.

resample.formula: src_index(i) = min(T - 1, floor(((2 * i + 1) * T) / (2 * L))) for i in 0..L-1, integer arithmetic
resample._evidence: datacheck v1 frame counts after trim: median 23, p75 45, p95 129; 67% of sequences have <= 32 frames

missing.when: after normalization and resampling, replace every NaN with fill_value

output.frame_layout: for each group in 'groups' order, for each point in that group's order: x, y; then the 4 presence masks in mask_order (1.0 present, 0.0 missing). upper_face has no mask of its own: it comes from the same face detection as lips.

capture._note: Resampling makes the model length-agnostic, but capture near the Kaggle frame rate keeps motion detail comparable.
